question: Our passes carry the right team on 68% (decision.json). Which way of giving an event its team is right most often, and does the best one make passes per team pass their test?
status: registered 2026-11-02 before any event of this run or any number below is computed; CPU; follows plan.json + addendum1.json (same clips, ball range, spotter, team mapping, truth, success rule, constants, bootstrap)
events: the same spotter, re-run (nested leave one match out, rate thresholds), events kept with their frame and class

methods.A: the nearest team-labelled player at the event frame (learn.py, as in decision.json)
methods.B: the team of the actor track by the possession rule (src/passer.py, rule C: -0.4 / +0.2 s, nearest detection within 3 m of the ball, most votes); the track's team is its most frequent team_A / team_B label
methods.C: the same window and ball, every frame's nearest player within 3 m votes its team (team_A / team_B only); most votes, ties to the vote nearest the event

team accuracy (selection): our passes and carries matched one-to-one to truth events of their class within 1 s; right = the method's team (mapped per clip as in plan.json) is the truth's side; no team counts as not right; pooled over the 10 matches, and per match
ceiling (diagnostic): per truth pass and carry, our player detection nearest the truth actor's position (within 3 m, nearest players' frame): the share whose team label is the truth's side, and the share with a team label at all
selection: the method with the most right teams pooled; A is kept on a tie
test: plan.json's share and success tests re-run with the selected method's teams (same constants, bootstrap, decision rule)
caveat: the method is selected and tested on the same matches, on a different measure (team accuracy) than the test (share, success)
